newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dexia Belgium says eligible for Bel-20 share index.
newsitem.headline: Dexia Belgium says eligible for Bel-20 share index.

text.p: Dexia Belgium, the Belgian arm of French-Belgian banking group Dexia, said on Wednesday its shares are eligible to be part of the Brussels bourse's Bel-20 index .BFX after the planned sale of a further 15.5 percent of its shares.

"Based on a simulation on volume and capitalisation after the public offering, we consider that we are well-placed to be eligible for a place in the Bel-20," Francois Narmon, chief executive officer of Dexia Belgium told a news conference.
"The decision has to be made by the Brussels bourse, which is usually done at the end of the year...we comply with the criteria for Bel-20 membership," he said.
Analysts have said earlier however that since there are already three banks in the Bel-20 index, the bourse might be hesitant to include another bank.
